question: Primal Kitchen brand origin
markdown:
Primal Kitchen was founded in 2015 in
Oxnard, California
, by wellness blogger
and author
Mark Sisson
alongside co-founder Morgan Buehler Zanotti
. Sisson, known for his paleo blog
Mark's Daily Apple
, launched the brand to provide healthy, real-food condiments free of industrial seed oils, dairy, and soy.
Wikipedia
Key Milestones
The Launch:
Debuted online in February 2015 with its flagship avocado oil-based mayonnaise, which sold out in a week.
Expansion:
Expanded rapidly into natural grocery stores like Whole Foods, adding salad dressings, avocado oils, and collagen bars.
Acquisition:
Acquired by Kraft Heinz in late 2018 for $200 million.
